## Pull request overview

This PR updates the console’s Home experience to use the same “unified sidebar” navigation shell as app routes by introducing a global `NavigationContext` and wiring both `HomeLayout` and `ConsoleLayout` to it.

**Changes:**
- Added `NavigationProvider` + `useNavigationContext` to track `home` vs `app` navigation mode and current app name.
- Replaced the old Home top bar layout with `AppShell + UnifiedSidebar + AppHeader`, and updated `ConsoleLayout` to use `UnifiedSidebar`.
- Adjusted Home page spacing and updated `HomeLayout` tests to match the new shell.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 7 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/pages/home/HomePage.tsx | Removes `container mx-auto` wrappers; uses simpler padding to fit the new shell. |
| apps/console/src/pages/home/HomeLayout.tsx | Replaces the legacy home header with `AppShell` + `UnifiedSidebar` + `AppHeader`, and sets nav context to `home`. |
| apps/console/src/context/NavigationContext.tsx | Introduces global navigation context/provider for sidebar mode switching. |
| apps/console/src/components/UnifiedSidebar.tsx | Adds the new contextual sidebar implementation with app switcher, areas, search, recents, favorites, pins, and mobile bottom nav. |
| apps/console/src/components/ConsoleLayout.tsx | Switches from `AppSidebar` to `UnifiedSidebar` and sets nav context to `app`. |
| apps/console/src/App.tsx | Wraps routing with `NavigationProvider`. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/HomeLayout.test.tsx | Updates tests to validate the new shell and navigation context behavior. |
</details>

`Button` is imported from `@object-ui/components` but never used in this file. With `noUnusedLocals: true` this will fail TypeScript compilation—please remove the unused import (or use it if intended).
```suggestion

```

`Plus` and `Grid3x3` are imported from `lucide-react` but not referenced anywhere in this file. Because the console tsconfig enables `noUnusedLocals`, these unused imports will break the build—please remove them.

This file re-introduces a local `getIcon()` helper that duplicates the existing shared utility at `apps/console/src/utils/getIcon.ts`, increasing maintenance cost and risking inconsistent icon resolution behavior across the console. Please use the shared `getIcon` utility instead of defining a new one here (and avoid importing the full `LucideIcons` namespace in multiple places).

The swipe-to-open effect registers `touchstart`/`touchend` listeners on `document` unconditionally, even when `isMobile` is false. This adds global listeners on desktop/tablet and can interfere with other touch handlers; please only attach these listeners when `isMobile` is true (and skip registering entirely otherwise).

`HomeLayout` renders `AppHeader`, but `AppHeader` currently derives `baseHref` as `/apps/${appNameFromRoute}` from the URL. On `/home` there is no `appName` param, so the breadcrumb link will become `/apps/undefined` (and may navigate to an invalid route). Please update `AppHeader` to handle non-app routes (home/system) or use a header variant that doesn’t assume `/apps/:appName` routing.

`NavigationProvider` is currently rendered *outside* `BrowserRouter`, which prevents it from using `react-router` APIs (e.g. `useLocation`) to initialize/update navigation context from the current route. If you want to avoid the initial Home→App sidebar flicker, consider moving `NavigationProvider` inside `BrowserRouter` (or otherwise derive initial context from `window.location`).
